files.description: Primary EHI export documentation: 26-page PDF titled '§170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information export_Self Attestation Document' for PrognoCIS Denali 3.1. Contains export workflow instructions, data element checklist (47 types), and detailed field-level data dictionary covering clinical, billing, and administrative data.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://prognocis.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/b-10-EHI-Export_PrognoCIS-Support.pdf' -H 'Referer: https://prognocis.com/macra/' -o b-10-EHI-Export_PrognoCIS-Support.pdf  # NOTE: site returns 403 to curl; must download via browser

files.description: Plain text extraction from the PDF (via pdftotext). Used as input for enrichment parsing.
Screenshot of the top of the MACRA compliance page where the EHI export PDF link is hosted.
Screenshot of the EHI export section on the MACRA compliance page, showing the PDF download link for §170.315(b)(10).
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the PDF text extraction into structured JSON. Extracts 47 data element types with field lists, descriptions, and metadata.

Enrichment output: structured JSON containing all 47 data element types from the EHI export documentation, with 1180 fields extracted across 40 elements (4 elements have no discrete field lists in the source). Includes checklist items, parse statistics, and per-element descriptions/notes.
Enrichment README with run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
